items.source:
Determines if there is a type converter available in the specified context and
attempts to use it to convert the supplied value to the specified type. Throws an
exception if conversion is not possible.
items.translation: 确定指定上下文中是否存在类型转换器，并尝试使用该转换器将提供的值转换为指定的类型。如果无法转换，则抛出异常。

items.source: EvaluationException - if there is a problem during conversion or conversion of the value to the specified type is not supported
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果在转换过程中出现问题，或者不支持将值转换为指定类型。

items.source: context - the evaluation context that may define a type converter
items.translation: context - 可能定义类型转换器的评估上下文

items.source: typedValue - the value to convert and a type descriptor describing it
items.translation: typedValue - 要转换的值及其类型描述符

items.source: targetType - the type to attempt conversion to
Common utility functions that may be used by any Expression Language provider.
items.translation: 任何表达式语言提供者可能使用的通用实用函数。
